status: private authored arrangements from source cells; no public release or regional approval

source.authors: Oscar Jeanluck Burgos Segura and Víctor Hugo Ñopo Olazábal
source.title: Transformaciones de la cumbia en la costa norte del Perú en las dos primeras décadas del siglo XXI
source.notation: Figure 14, printed p. 161 / PDF p. 20; left and right panels rendered at 4x and visually read. Figures 2–3 were inspected in the preceding source-cell pass.
source.readerStatus: one-reader interpretation; independent notation and local musician comparison pending

timing.mapping: divide every adopted source tick by two; source half-note pulse becomes machine quarter-note pulse
timing.notClaimed: unmodified note-value notation, source microtiming or a universal regional tempo

palette.kick: Compás procedural kick; not a sample of the source kit
palette.upperPercussion: Compás shake voice for the hi-hat role; not a faithful hi-hat emulation
palette.bongo: 727 high bongó in the review set; low/open/closed/palm source strokes collapse to one sample. Accent gains are authored.
palette.conga: 727 muted/open high conga in the review set. Source open-stroke positions use event 2, which couples open timbre and stronger velocity; palm and slap collapse. No independent source dynamic is inferred.
palette.timbal: Compás procedural shell voice. The source jam-block line is deliberately omitted, not relabelled as shell.
palette.bass: Compás ensemble bass; all relative pitches are authored and the live lead is left unprogrammed

entries.reference: Motor y motivo / Grupo 5, Figure 14 left; Figure 2 upper cell
entries.authored: Root/bVI bass reduction, all velocities and fader levels, Energy accents, last-beat fills and six conductor gestures. Source bass pitches and piano voicings are not adopted.
notClaimed: the complete Motor y motivo arrangement

entries.reference: Dios mío, haz que me enamore / Armonía 10, Figure 14 right; Figure 3 fragmented shell
entries.authored: Root/bVII bass reduction, all velocities and fader levels, Energy accents, last-beat fills and six conductor gestures. Source bass pitches are not adopted. The continuing upper cell is retained independently from the sparse shell.
notClaimed: every cumbión or a canonical quebradita

liveForm.labelBoundary: The following keys identify engine slots. The screen retains Cumbia-family labels; none claims the source recording's actual section order.
liveForm.intro: First bar isolates Hat/Bass, second bar opens the body; the next phrase enters Verse A.
liveForm.verseA: Source-cell body with authored bass and levels.
liveForm.verseB: Base first bar, Lift accents in the second.
liveForm.chorus: Lift accents, preserving the distinct shell/upper roles.
liveForm.break: Hat/Bass only; room for a live singer or instrumental call.
liveForm.ending: One Hat/Bass phrase, then the existing stop/next-song behaviour.
liveForm.fill: ARP arms authored last-beat replies into the selected part. No source fill is claimed.

releaseGate: Independent notation reading and north-coast percussionist/arranger review; current real-bank resource and cue tests before any candidate promotion. These studies are a separate development branch, not an update to the qualified RC3 install package.
